newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norske sees higher pulp prices next year.
newsitem.headline: Norske sees higher pulp prices next year.

text.p: Norske Skogindustrier ASA, Norway's biggest forestry company, said on Monday it expects pulp prices to rise at the beginning of next year.

"The market development has been positive and it is reasonable to expect an increase in pulp prices to $600 per tonne at the beginning of next year," Claes-Inge Isacson, in charge of the Pulp and Magazine Paper Division, said.
The price is now $560 per tonne.
But he said the company would not raise prices now.
"We may in the end adjust the prices in consultation with our clients. We are following the market situation," Isacson told Reuters.
